graphEvents.label: Which spec-kit runtime tests and runners are redundant
test:sharded is dead and strictly slower

label: 352 test files and 92362 lines in system-spec-kit/runtime, 214 of them in cli/tests
spec-kit-check check job runs five npm ci installs and three builds before the first test lane under a 51-minute timeout
test:sharded runs 12 shards sequentially and no workflow or script invokes it
run-tests.mjs embeds a 40-line inline Python process-group killer to bound a 10-minute test run
Three legacy harnesses totalling 3561 lines run as a separate CI lane beside the Vitest suites
progressive-validation files share a basename but zero test names (64 vs 68), so basename collision is not duplication
One package exposes six overlapping test entry points, so local suite cost depends on which one a person picks
